prayers.title: Sign of the Cross
prayers.content: In the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen.

prayers.title: Apostles' Creed
prayers.content: I believe in God, the Father almighty, Creator of heaven and earth. I believe in Jesus Christ, his only Son, our Lord...

prayers.title: The Lord's Prayer
prayers.content: Our Father, who art in heaven, hallowed be thy name; thy kingdom come; thy will be done on earth as it is in heaven...

prayers.title: Hail Mary (Faith)
prayers.content: Hail Mary, full of grace, the Lord is with thee...

prayers.title: Glory Be
prayers.content: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be. Amen.

prayers.title: First Joyful Mystery
prayers.content:
The Annunciation
Mary, you are full of grace, the Lord is with you... (Begin ten Hail Marys)
